title: Chelsea Buns
subtitle: Enriched dough rolls with currants and brown sugar
excerpt: A soft, enriched dough rolled flat with a filling of butter, currants, mixed spice, and dark brown sugar, then tightly rolled and sliced into rounds and baked touching in a tin. Glazed with warm sugar syrup.

recipe.sourceNotes: Chelsea buns were created at the Chelsea Bun House in Chelsea, London, which opened in the early 18th century and was reportedly visited by King George II and King George III. The original Chelsea Bun House closed in 1839, but the buns it created have remained a staple of British bakeries. They are coiled buns made from an enriched dough with currants and sugar, pulled apart at the table. The shape — each bun baked in contact with its neighbours — means the sides stay soft while the tops brown, giving a characteristic square cross-section.

recipeTools.notes: A 23 x 23 cm square tin, or a baking tray with sides.

content.text: The dough is enriched with egg and butter, which makes it soft and slightly sticky. Flour your hands and work surface generously. Roll the dough into a rectangle before spreading the filling: aim for an even thickness, about 5 mm. Roll tightly so the filling does not fall out when sliced. Pack the sliced buns snugly in the tin so they bake in contact with each other and stay soft on the sides.

Mix the flour, yeast, caster sugar, and salt. Rub in the 50 g softened butter. Add the egg and warm milk. Mix to a soft dough. Knead for 8 to 10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Cover and leave to rise for 1 hour until doubled.
Roll the dough into a 35 x 25 cm rectangle. Spread the remaining 50 g softened butter over the surface. Scatter over the brown sugar, currants, and mixed spice.
Roll up tightly from the long side. Cut into 12 equal rounds. Place snugly in a greased tin. Cover and prove for 30 minutes.

Heat the oven to 190 C / fan 170 C / gas 5. Bake for 22 to 25 minutes until golden. Meanwhile, dissolve the 3 tbsp caster sugar in 3 tbsp water in a small pan. Brush over the hot buns immediately. Pull apart and serve warm.
